observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > 25 simultaneous redeploys of one tenant start exactly one deployment, every round
observations.expected: every round: one dispatched, the rest refused as in progress, one active row

observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > negative control: with the unique index dropped, the same race starts many deployments
observations.step: The same race without the index (negative control)
observations.expected: duplicates appear, showing the index is what prevents them

observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > 25 simultaneous terminal callbacks finish a deployment once, every round
observations.expected: every round: exactly one callback applied

observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > 25 simultaneous secrets claims for one deployment release once, every round
observations.expected: every round: secrets released to exactly one run, which the row names

observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > an attacker's parallel burst neither reaches a foreign tenant nor blocks its owner
observations.step: 25 parallel cross-tenant redeploys beside the owner's × 20 rounds
observations.expected: every round: all attacker requests refused, the owner's one deployment dispatched

observations.test: SEC-CONC · real PostgreSQL, parallel transactions > an attacker's parallel burst neither reaches a foreign tenant nor blocks its owner
observations.step: The owner's own redeploy during the burst
